unitTitle: Be Going To - Will - Present Continuous - It Will Be/There Will Be

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in with will or the correct form of be going to. (items 14-15)
exercises.instructionUz: 'will' yoki 'be going to' ning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring. (14-15-bandlar)
exercises.explanationUz:
57-BETDAGI 2-MAShQNING DAVOMI.

JAVOBLAR:
  14  I'LL make you a sandwich.
  15  I'M GOING TO visit my aunt.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  14  A: Qornim ochdi.
      B: Senga buterbrod tayyorlayman.
  15  A: Bugun kechqurun sayrga chiqaylikmi?
      B: Kechirasan, bora olmayman. Xolamnikiga
         boraman.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  14  A qornining ochligini AYTDI →
      B AYNI DAMDA buterbrod tayyorlashni taklif
      qildi → WILL.
      Bu — 57-betdagi 'MUAMMO → YORDAM TAKLIFI'
      naqshi.

  15  B taklifni RAD ETADI va SABABINI aytadi.
      Xolasinikiga borish ALLAQAChON
      rejalashtirilgan (shuning uchun bora
      olmaydi) → BE GOING TO.
      Agar 'will' bo'lsa — endigina qaror qilgan
      bo'lardi, lekin unda taklifni rad etishga
      sabab bo'lmasdi.


DIQQAT — 15-BAND MANTIQI:
  'Sorry, I can't' — nega bora olmaydi?
  Chunki BOShQA REJASI bor.
  Reja OLDINDAN mavjud → BE GOING TO.

  Bu — Coursebook 97-betdagi muloyim rad etish
  qolipi bilan bir xil:
  'I'd love to, but I can't. I'm going to ...'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an aunt = xola, amma
  Shall we ...? = ... qilaylikmi? (taklif)

items.textEn: 14  A: I'm hungry.  B: I ............ make you a sandwich.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.
A qornining ochligini aytdi, B darhol yordam
taklif qildi.
'MUAMMO → YORDAM TAKLIFI' naqshi.

items.textEn: 15  A: Shall we go out tonight?  B: Sorry, I can't. I ............ visit my aunt.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — ALLAQACHON rejalashtirgan.
'Sorry, I can't' — nega bora olmaydi?
Chunki BOSHQA REJASI bor.
Reja OLDINDAN mavjud bo'lgani uchun taklifni
rad etyapti.
Coursebook 97-betdagi rad etish qolipi bilan
bir xil.

exercises.instructionEn: It's Jill's birthday next Saturday and she's going to have a party. First, look at the pictures and match them with the prompts in the list below.
exercises.instructionUz: Keyingi shanba Jillning tug'ilgan kuni va u ziyofat qilmoqchi. Avval rasmlarga qarang va ularni quyidagi ro'yxatdagi ko'rsatmalarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT KO'RSATMA:
  buy / coke and crisps
     (kola va chips sotib olmoq)
  hire / a band
     (musiqa guruhini yollamoq)
  send / invitations / to friends
     (do'stlarga taklifnoma yubormoq)
  make / birthday cake
     (tug'ilgan kun torti pishirmoq)


TO'RT RASM:
  1  'INVITATION' yozuvli kartochka va sharlar
  2  Musiqachilar guruhi (trombon, baraban)
  3  Shamlar qadalgan tug'ilgan kun torti
  4  Kola bankasi, chips paketi, shokolad


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  →  send invitations to friends
  2  →  hire a band
  3  →  make birthday cake
  4  →  buy coke and crisps


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:
  Har bir rasm ANIQ bir ko'rsatmani ko'rsatadi —
  taxmin qilishga hojat yo'q:
     'INVITATION' so'zi kartochkada YOZILGAN
     Musiqachilar → 'a band'
     Tort va shamlar → 'birthday cake'
     Kola va chips → 'coke and crisps'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to hire      = yollamoq, ijaraga olmoq
  a band       = musiqa guruhi
  an invitation = taklifnoma
  coke         = kola ('Coca-Cola' dan)
  crisps       = chips (Britaniya;
                 Amerikada 'chips')
  a birthday cake = tug'ilgan kun torti

pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda 'INVITATION' so'zi ANIQ yozilgan.
Sharlar ham bayram belgisi.
'send sth TO sb' — predlog TO.

Rasmda musiqa asboblari bilan uch kishi →
'a band' (musiqa guruhi).
'to hire' = yollamoq (pul evaziga chaqirmoq).

Tort va ustidagi shamlar → tug'ilgan kun torti.
'MAKE a cake' = tort pishirmoq
('do a cake' XATO).

Rasmda 'COLA' va 'CRISPS' yozuvlari ko'rinadi.
'crisps' — Britaniya varianti
(Amerikada 'chips').

exercises.instructionEn: Then make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  'She'S GOING TO send invitations to her
      friends.'


NEGA 'BE GOING TO':
  Jill ziyofat qilishni REJALAShTIRGAN.
  Bu ishlar uning NIYATLARI —
  aniq vaqti belgilanmagan.

  Mashq boshida ham aytilgan:
  'she'S GOING TO have a party.'


QOLIP:
  She'S GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .


BARCHA TO'RT GAP:

  1  She's going to send invitations to her
     friends.                          (NAMUNA)
  2  She's going to hire a band.
  3  She's going to make a birthday cake.
  4  She's going to buy coke and crisps.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  U do'stlariga taklifnoma yubormoqchi.
  2  U musiqa guruhini yollamoqchi.
  3  U tug'ilgan kun torti pishirmoqchi.
  4  U kola va chips sotib olmoqchi.


DIQQAT — 1-GAPDA 'HER':
  Ko'rsatmada 'to friends' deyilgan,
  lekin namunada 'to HER friends' —
  ya'ni egalik olmoshi qo'shilgan.
  Gap TABIIYROQ bo'ladi.

DIQQAT — 3-GAPDA 'A':
  Ko'rsatmada 'make/birthday cake',
  gapda esa 'make A birthday cake' —
  artikl qo'shiladi.


DIQQAT — 'MAKE' va 'DO' FARQI:
  'MAKE a cake'  ✓  (yasash, tayyorlash)
  'DO a cake'    ✗
  Shunday: make a sandwich, make dinner,
  make a party (lekin 'HAVE a party' to'g'riroq).

modelSentences.sentence: She's going to send invitations to her friends.
modelSentences.uz: U do'stlariga taklifnoma yubormoqchi. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — 'to HER friends')

modelSentences.sentence: She's going to hire a band.
modelSentences.uz: U musiqa guruhini yollamoqchi. ('to hire' = yollamoq)

modelSentences.sentence: She's going to make a birthday cake.
modelSentences.uz: U tug'ilgan kun torti pishirmoqchi. ('MAKE a cake', 'do a cake' XATO)

modelSentences.sentence: She's going to buy coke and crisps.
modelSentences.uz: U kola va chips sotib olmoqchi. ('crisps' — britancha)

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words/phrases from the list to complete the sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdagi so'z va iboralardan foydalaning, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (5 ta ibora):
  sell her car, be late for school, fix,
  make a cake, lose weight


HAR GAPDA IKKI QISM:
  1-gap — HOZIRGI DALIL (nima ko'rinib turibdi)
  2-gap — BAShORAT yoki REJA ('be going to')

  Bu — 57-betdagi qoida:
  'be going to' DALILGA asoslangan bashorat
  uchun ham ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  Jane's putting an ad in the newspaper.
     She IS GOING TO SELL HER CAR.       (NAMUNA)

  2  The washing machine isn't working.
     My father IS GOING TO FIX IT.

  3  I bought some flour and some eggs.
     I AM GOING TO MAKE A CAKE.

  4  Robert is on a diet.
     He IS GOING TO LOSE WEIGHT.

  5  Peter is still in bed.
     He IS GOING TO BE LATE FOR SCHOOL.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Jeyn gazetaga e'lon beryapti.
     U mashinasini sotmoqchi.
  2  Kir yuvish mashinasi ishlamayapti.
     Otam uni tuzatmoqchi.
  3  Men un va tuxum sotib oldim.
     Tort pishirmoqchiman.
  4  Robert parhezda.
     U vazn tashlamoqchi.
  5  Piter hali ham karavotda.
     U maktabga kechikadi.


HAR BIRI QANDAY ANIQLANADI — DALIL → NATIJA:

  1  DALIL: gazetaga e'lon berayapti
     → mashinani SOTMOQChI

  2  DALIL: kir yuvish mashinasi buzilgan
     → otasi uni TUZATMOQChI

  3  DALIL: un va tuxum sotib olindi
     → TORT PIShIRMOQChI
     (un va tuxum — tortning masalliqlari)

  4  DALIL: Robert parhezda
     → VAZN TAShLAMOQChI
     (parhezning maqsadi shu)

  5  DALIL: Piter hali karavotda
     → MAKTABGA KEChIKADI
     DIQQAT: bu REJA emas, BAShORAT!
     Piter kechikishni xohlamaydi, lekin
     dalil shuni ko'rsatadi.


ENG MUHIM — 5-BAND FARQ QILADI:
  1-4-bandlarda 'be going to' — REJA/NIYAT.
  5-bandda esa DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT:
  Piter kechikishni REJALAShTIRMAGAN, lekin
  hali karavotda bo'lgani uchun kechikishi
  ANIQ.

  Bu — 'be going to' ning IKKINChI vazifasi
  (57-bet).


EGALARGA E'TIBOR BERING:
  1  She  → 'She IS going to'
  2  My father → 'He IS going to'
  3  I    → 'I AM going to'
  4  He   → 'He IS going to'
  5  He   → 'He IS going to'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an ad (advertisement) = e'lon, reklama
  a washing machine = kir yuvish mashinasi
  to fix       = tuzatmoq, ta'mirlamoq
  flour        = un
  a diet       = parhez
  to be on a diet = parhezda bo'lmoq
  to be late for = ... ga kechikmoq
  still        = hali ham

items.sentence: 1  Jane's putting an ad in the newspaper.  She ............ .
items.answer: is going to sell her car

commonMistake.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
DALIL: gazetaga e'lon beryapti.
→ mashinasini SOTMOQCHI.
'an ad' = e'lon (advertisement ning qisqargani).

items.sentence: 2  The washing machine isn't working.  My father ............ .

commonMistake.whyUz:
DALIL: kir yuvish mashinasi buzilgan.
→ otasi uni TUZATMOQCHI.
'to fix' = tuzatmoq, ta'mirlamoq.
DIQQAT: 'IT' qo'shiladi (mashinani).
'My father' — 3-shaxs birlik → 'IS going to'.

items.sentence: 3  I bought some flour and some eggs.  I ............ .
items.answer: am going to make a cake

commonMistake.whyUz:
DALIL: un va tuxum sotib olindi —
bular TORTNING masalliqlari.
→ TORT PISHIRMOQCHI.
'flour' = un (DIQQAT: 'flower' — gul, bir xil
o'qiladi!).
'I' → 'AM going to'.

items.sentence: 4  Robert is on a diet.  He ............ .

commonMistake.whyUz:
DALIL: Robert parhezda.
→ VAZN TASHLAMOQCHI (parhezning maqsadi shu).
'be ON a diet' = parhezda bo'lmoq (predlog ON).
'lose weight' = vazn tashlamoq.

items.sentence: 5  Peter is still in bed.  He ............ .
items.answer: is going to be late for school

commonMistake.whyUz:
DALIL: Piter hali ham karavotda.
→ MAKTABGA KECHIKADI.

DIQQAT — BU BAND FARQ QILADI:
1-4-bandlarda 'be going to' — REJA/NIYAT.
Bu yerda esa DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BASHORAT:
Piter kechikishni XOHLAMAYDI, lekin dalil
shuni ko'rsatadi.
'be late FOR' — predlog FOR.
'still' = hali ham.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in will or be going to and one of the verbs from the list, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: 'will' yoki 'be going to' va ro'yxatdagi fe'llardan birini to'ldiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (10 ta fe'l, 10 ta bo'shliq):
  visit, paint, clean, have, cook, rain, drive,
  stay, phone, answer

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  I AM GOING TO VISIT my parents.   (NAMUNA)
   2  I'LL HAVE the steak, please.
   3  It'S GOING TO RAIN this afternoon.
   4  I'LL PHONE her tomorrow morning.
   5  I'M GOING TO PAINT the house.
   6  I'LL ANSWER it.
   7  He'S GOING TO STAY at home and relax.
   8  They'RE GOING TO DRIVE to the beach.
   9  I'LL CLEAN it.
  10  I'LL COOK dinner.

  WILL — BESHTA:        2, 4, 6, 9, 10
  BE GOING TO — BESHTA: 1, 3, 5, 7, 8


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  A: Bugun kechqurunga rejang bormi?
      B: Ha, ota-onamnikiga boraman.
   2  A: Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz, janob?
      B: Ha, bifshteks olaman, iltimos.
   3  A: Osmonda qora bulutlar bor.
      B: Bugun tushdan keyin yomg'ir yog'adi.
   4  A: O'qituvchim siz bilan gaplashmoqchi.
      B: Mayli, ertaga ertalab unga qo'ng'iroq
         qilaman.
   5  A: Nega bu cho'tkalarni sotib olding?
      B: Uyni bo'yamoqchiman.
   6  A: Kimdir eshikni taqillatyapti.
      B: Men ochaman.
   7  A: Uning dam olish kunlariga rejasi qanday?
      B: U uyda qolib dam olmoqchi.
   8  A: Jonsonlar ertaga nima qilishadi?
      B: Ular plyajga haydab borishmoqchi.
   9  A: Bu uy tartibsiz!
      B: Xavotir olma, men uni yig'ishtiraman.
  10  A: Qornim ochdi!
      B: Mayli, kechki ovqat tayyorlayman.


HAR BIRI QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

   2  RESTORAN — 'Are you ready to order?'
      Menyuga qarab AYNI DAMDA tanladi → WILL.
      Fe'l: 'HAVE' (buyurtma berishda
      'I'll have ...' — turg'un ibora).

   3  DALIL: 'There are dark clouds in the sky.'
      → BE GOING TO (dalilga asoslangan bashorat).
      Fe'l: RAIN.
      Bu — 56 va 57-betlardagi namunaning
      aynan o'zi.

   4  'Okay' — ayni damdagi reaksiya → WILL.
      Fe'l: PHONE (qo'ng'iroq qilmoq).

   5  'Why did you BUY those brushes?'
      Cho'tkalarni ALLAQAChON sotib olgan →
      reja OLDINDAN bor → BE GOING TO.
      Fe'l: PAINT.

   6  Eshik taqillayapti → AYNI DAMDA javob
      berishga qaror qildi → WILL.
      Fe'l: ANSWER ('answer the door' = eshikni
      ochmoq).

   7  'What are his PLANS?' — reja so'ralmoqda →
      BE GOING TO.
      Fe'l: STAY.

   8  'What are the Johnsons DOING tomorrow?' —
      reja so'ralmoqda → BE GOING TO.
      Fe'l: DRIVE.
      Ega KO'PLIK → 'They'RE going to'.

   9  'Don't worry' — ayni damdagi yordam
      taklifi → WILL.
      Fe'l: CLEAN.

  10  'Okay' — ayni damdagi qaror → WILL.
      Fe'l: COOK.


NAQSh — IKKI TUR:

  WILL:
     A biror MUAMMO yoki HOLATNI aytadi,
     B AYNI DAMDA javob beradi.
     Belgilari: 'Okay', 'Don't worry',
     restoranda buyurtma.

  BE GOING TO:
     'plans' so'zi bor, yoki DALIL bor
     (qora bulutlar, sotib olingan cho'tkalar).


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDAGI 'I'LL HAVE':
  Restoranda buyurtma berishda DOIM 'I'll have
  ...' deyiladi:
     'I'll have the steak, please.'
     'I'll have a coffee, please.'
  Bu — turg'un ibora.

DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'ANSWER':
  'answer the phone' = telefonga javob bermoq
  'answer the door'  = eshikni ochmoq
  Bu yerda eshik haqida → 'I'll answer IT.'

DIQQAT — 5-BAND MANTIQI:
  Cho'tkalar ALLAQAChON sotib olingan —
  demak bo'yash rejasi OLDINDAN bor edi.
  Shuning uchun 'will' emas, 'be going to'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to order    = buyurtma bermoq
  a steak     = bifshteks
  a brush     = cho'tka
  to knock    = taqillatmoq
  a mess      = tartibsizlik
  to relax    = dam olmoq

items.textEn: 1  A: Have you got any plans for this evening?  B: Yes, I ............ my parents.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA.
'plans' so'zi savolda bor → BE GOING TO.
Fe'l: VISIT.

items.textEn: 2  A: Are you ready to order, sir?  B: Yes, I ............ the steak, please.
items.whyUz:
WILL — menyuga qarab AYNI DAMDA tanladi.
Fe'l: HAVE.
DIQQAT: restoranda buyurtma berishda DOIM
'I'LL HAVE ...' deyiladi — turg'un ibora.
'a steak' = bifshteks.

items.textEn: 3  A: There are dark clouds in the sky.  B: It ............ this afternoon.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — DALILGA asoslangan bashorat.
DALIL: 'There are dark clouds in the sky.'
Fe'l: RAIN.
Bu — 56 va 57-betlardagi namunaning aynan o'zi.

items.textEn: 4  A: My teacher wants to speak to you.  B: Okay, I ............ her tomorrow morning.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.
'Okay' so'zi buni ko'rsatadi.
Fe'l: PHONE (qo'ng'iroq qilmoq, predlogSIZ).

items.textEn: 5  A: Why did you buy those brushes?  B: I ............ the house.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — reja OLDINDAN bor.
Cho'tkalar ALLAQACHON sotib olingan —
demak bo'yash rejasi oldindan mavjud.
Fe'l: PAINT.
'a brush' = cho'tka.

items.textEn: 6  A: There's somebody knocking at the door.  B: I ............ it.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.
Eshik taqillayapti, B darhol javob berishga
qaror qildi.
Fe'l: ANSWER.
DIQQAT: 'answer the door' = eshikni ochmoq
('answer the phone' = telefonga javob bermoq).

items.textEn: 7  A: What are his plans for the weekend?  B: He ............ at home and relax.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — savolda 'PLANS' so'zi bevosita
aytilgan.
Fe'l: STAY.
'stay AT home' — predlog AT, artikl YO'Q.
'and relax' — ikkinchi fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

items.textEn: 8  A: What are the Johnsons doing tomorrow?  B: They ............ to the beach.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — kelajak rejasi so'ralmoqda.
Fe'l: DRIVE.
DIQQAT — EGA: 'They' KO'PLIK →
'They ARE going to' ('They're going to').
'the Johnsons' = Jonsonlar oilasi.

items.textEn: 9  A: This house is a mess!  B: Don't worry, I ............ it.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA yordam taklifi.
'Don't worry' so'zi buni ko'rsatadi.
Fe'l: CLEAN.
'a mess' = tartibsizlik.

items.textEn: 10  A: I'm hungry!  B: Okay, I ............ dinner.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.
'Okay' so'zi buni ko'rsatadi.
Fe'l: COOK.
'cook dinner' — artikl YO'Q.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the future simple, be going to or the present continuous, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni kelasi oddiy zamon, 'be going to' yoki 'present continuous' ga qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
ENDI UCh XIL KELAJAK ARALAShTIRILGAN —
Unit 13 ning eng qiyin mashqi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  He IS GOING TO BE an artist.        (NAMUNA)
  2  I'm sure Kelly WILL LET you borrow her CDs.
  3  Look at him! He IS GOING TO FALL off his
     bike.
  4  They ARE HAVING dinner at Mario's on Saturday
     evening.
  5  I can't see you at the weekend. I AM VISITING
     my parents.
  6  I'm cold. I WILL PUT ON my jacket.
  7  He IS MEETING Lisa for coffee at noon.
  8  I AM FLYING to Madrid next month.
  9  Don't worry, I WILL CALL the plumber for the
     dishwasher.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  U rasm chizishni yaxshi ko'radi.
     U rassom bo'lmoqchi.
  2  Ishonchim komilki, Kelli senga o'z
     disklarini beradi.
  3  Unga qara! U velosipeddan yiqiladi.
  4  Ular shanba kechqurun 'Mario's' da kechki
     ovqat qilishadi.
  5  Dam olish kunlari sen bilan ko'risha
     olmayman. Ota-onamnikiga boraman.
  6  Sovqotdim. Kurtkamni kiyaman.
  7  U tushda Liza bilan qahva ichgani
     uchrashadi.
  8  Keyingi oy Madridga uchaman.
  9  Xavotir olma, idish yuvish mashinasi uchun
     santexnikni chaqiraman.


UCh QOIDA — QAYSI BIRINI TANLASh:

  BE GOING TO:
     • REJA / NIYAT
     • DALILGA asoslangan bashorat

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     • QAT'IY BELGILANGAN ish (ANIQ VAQT bor)

  WILL:
     • FIKRGA asoslangan bashorat ('I'm sure',
       'I think')
     • AYNI DAMDAGI qaror


HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

  1  'He LIKES PAINTING.' → NIYAT.
     BE GOING TO.                       (NAMUNA)

  2  'I'M SURE Kelly ...' →
     'I'm sure' = FIKR, ishonch.
     Dalil yo'q → WILL.
     'let sb DO sth' — 'to' YO'Q:
     'let you BORROW' ✓ ('let you to borrow' ✗).

  3  'LOOK AT HIM!' →
     Hozir KO'RINIB turgan DALIL
     (bola muvozanatini yo'qotdi) →
     BE GOING TO.

  4  'ON SATURDAY EVENING' + restoran nomi →
     ANIQ VAQT, joy band qilingan →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

  5  'I CAN'T SEE YOU at the weekend.' →
     Nega ko'risha olmaydi? Chunki BOShQA
     BELGILANGAN ishi bor →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
     ('am going to visit' ham mumkin, lekin
      kelishilgan reja uchun present continuous
      tabiiyroq.)

  6  'I'M COLD.' → AYNI DAMDAGI qaror → WILL.
     'put ON' — ikki so'zli fe'l (kiymoq).

  7  'AT NOON' → ANIQ VAQT →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
     'meet sb FOR coffee' — predlog FOR.

  8  'NEXT MONTH' + 'FLY' (harakat fe'li) →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
     57-bet: harakat fe'llari (come, go, FLY,
     travel, leave) kelajak rejasida present
     continuous da keladi.

  9  'DON'T WORRY' → AYNI DAMDAGI yordam
     taklifi → WILL.


ENG MUHIM — 4, 5, 7, 8-BANDLAR:
  Hammasida ANIQ VAQT bor:
     'on Saturday evening'  (4)
     'at the weekend'       (5)
     'at noon'              (7)
     'next month'           (8)
  → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

  8-bandda qo'shimcha dalil: 'FLY' — harakat
  fe'li.


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDAGI 'LET':
  'let sb DO sth' — 'to' YO'Q!
     'Kelly will let you BORROW her CDs.'  ✓
     'Kelly will let you TO borrow ...'    ✗
  Shunday: 'make sb do sth', 'help sb do sth'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an artist    = rassom
  to let       = ruxsat bermoq
  to borrow    = qarzga olmoq
  to fall off  = ... dan yiqilmoq
  a jacket     = kurtka
  at noon      = tushda (soat 12 da)
  a plumber    = santexnik ('b' O'QILMAYDI)
  a dishwasher = idish yuvish mashinasi

items.textEn: 1  He likes painting. He ............ (be) an artist.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA.
'He LIKES PAINTING' → bu uning NIYATI.
BE GOING TO — reja/niyat.
'an artist' = rassom.

items.textEn: 2  I'm sure Kelly ............ (let) you borrow her CDs.
items.whyUz:
WILL — FIKRGA asoslangan bashorat.
'I'M SURE' = ishonchim komil — bu shunchaki
FIKR, ko'rinib turgan DALIL yo'q.

DIQQAT — 'LET' DAN KEYIN 'TO' YO'Q:
'let you BORROW' ✓
'let you TO borrow' ✗
Shunday: make sb do, help sb do.

items.textEn: 3  Look at him! He ............ (fall) off his bike.
items.whyUz:
BE GOING TO — DALILGA asoslangan bashorat.
'LOOK AT HIM!' — dalil HOZIR ko'rinib turibdi
(bola muvozanatini yo'qotgan).
'fall OFF' = ... dan yiqilmoq (predlog OFF).

items.textEn: 4  They ............ (have) dinner at Mario's on Saturday evening.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — QAT'IY BELGILANGAN ish.
'ON SATURDAY EVENING' — ANIQ VAQT,
restoranda joy band qilingan.
57-betdagi qoida.

items.textEn: 5  I can't see you at the weekend. I ............ (visit) my parents.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — QAT'IY BELGILANGAN ish.
'I CAN'T SEE YOU at the weekend' — nega?
Chunki BOSHQA belgilangan ishi bor.
'at the weekend' — ANIQ VAQT.

ESLATMA: 'am going to visit' ham grammatik
jihatdan mumkin, lekin KELISHILGAN reja uchun
present continuous tabiiyroq — 4, 7, 8-bandlar
ham shu naqshda.

items.textEn: 6  I'm cold. I ............ (put on) my jacket.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.
'I'M COLD' — sovqotgani uchun darhol qaror
qildi.
'put ON' = kiymoq (ikki so'zli fe'l).
Coursebook 95-betdagi 11-mashqda ham shu naqsh.

items.textEn: 7  He ............ (meet) Lisa for coffee at noon.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — QAT'IY BELGILANGAN ish.
'AT NOON' — ANIQ VAQT (soat 12).
Kelishilgan uchrashuv.
'meet sb FOR coffee' — predlog FOR.

items.textEn: 8  I ............ (fly) to Madrid next month.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — IKKI DALIL:
  1) 'NEXT MONTH' — aniq vaqt
  2) 'FLY' — HARAKAT FE'LI
57-bet: harakat fe'llari (come, go, FLY, travel,
leave) kelajak rejasida present continuous da
keladi.
Chipta olingan.

items.textEn: 9  Don't worry, I ............ (call) the plumber for the dishwasher.
items.whyUz:
WILL — AYNI DAMDA yordam taklifi.
'DON'T WORRY' so'zi buni ko'rsatadi.
'a plumber' = santexnik ('b' O'QILMAYDI:
'PLA-mer').
'a dishwasher' = idish yuvish mashinasi.

patterns.formula: [HOZIRGI DALIL]. ega + is/am/are GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Robert is on a diet. He is going to lose weight. Peter is still in bed. He is going to be late for school.
patterns.exampleUz: Robert parhezda. U vazn tashlamoqchi. Piter hali ham karavotda. U maktabga kechikadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Avval DALIL, keyin natija.
DIQQAT: oxirgi misolda bu REJA emas —
DALILGA asoslangan BASHORAT.

patterns.exampleEn: Are you ready to order, sir? — Yes, I'll have the steak, please.
patterns.exampleUz: Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz, janob? — Ha, bifshteks olaman, iltimos.
patterns.explanationUz:
Restoranda buyurtma berishda DOIM
'I'll have ...' — turg'un ibora.

patterns.exampleEn: They are having dinner at Mario's on Saturday evening. I am flying to Madrid next month.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular shanba kechqurun 'Mario's' da kechki ovqat qilishadi. Keyingi oy Madridga uchaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
ANIQ VAQT bo'lsa → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
Harakat fe'llari (fly, go, come, leave) bilan
ayniqsa ko'p.

patterns.formula: I'M SURE + ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: I'm sure Kelly will let you borrow her CDs.
patterns.exampleUz: Ishonchim komilki, Kelli senga o'z disklarini beradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'I'm sure' — FIKR, dalil yo'q → WILL.
DIQQAT: 'let sb DO sth' — 'to' YO'Q.

patterns.formula: She'S GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .   (ziyofat rejalari)
patterns.exampleEn: She's going to send invitations to her friends. She's going to hire a band.
patterns.exampleUz: U do'stlariga taklifnoma yubormoqchi. U musiqa guruhini yollamoqchi.
patterns.explanationUz: REJA va NIYAT — aniq vaqt YO'Q.
